content: This old man is about to die, but you are still young. You are the Saintess of this Vine-Bead Court, and you will become the Great Elder of this Vine-Bead Court.

raw: [name="Great Elder"]Go forth and instruct him, overcome him. Make him understand that in the face of faith itself, his actions are insignificant, beneath even mention!
speaker: Great Elder
content: Go forth and instruct him, overcome him. Make him understand that in the face of faith itself, his actions are insignificant, beneath even mention!

raw: Enya remains silent for a while, but forces herself free of the Great Elder's grip.
content: Enya remains silent for a while, but forces herself free of the Great Elder's grip.

She feels pity for the old man before her, but she feels a greater determination.
content: She feels pity for the old man before her, but she feels a greater determination.

speaker: Enya
content: ...I disagree, Great Elder.

raw: [name="Enya"]You say that faith equals stagnation, and that people depend on faith because they demand stability.
speaker: Enya
content: You say that faith equals stagnation, and that people depend on faith because they demand stability.

raw: [name="Enya"]But that's not how I see things.
speaker: Enya
content: But that's not how I see things.

raw: [name="Enya"]It is true that once people accept a faith, they come to rely on it. Laziness, escapism, decadence... I can't argue those.
speaker: Enya
content: It is true that once people accept a faith, they come to rely on it. Laziness, escapism, decadence... I can't argue those.

raw: [name="Enya"]But this does not mean that faith itself is stagnation.
speaker: Enya
content: But this does not mean that faith itself is stagnation.

raw: [name="Enya"]Faith is just faith, nothing more. It has no attributes by itself, and its substance comes from what is put into it.
speaker: Enya
content: Faith is just faith, nothing more. It has no attributes by itself, and its substance comes from what is put into it.

raw: [name="Enya"]If the faith progresses, then the faithful will progress with it.
speaker: Enya
content: If the faith progresses, then the faithful will progress with it.

raw: [name="Enya"]If the faith stagnates, then the faithful will stagnate with it.
speaker: Enya
content: If the faith stagnates, then the faithful will stagnate with it.

raw: [name="Enya"]The reason why you think the people of Kjerag crave stagnation is precisely because Kjeragandr's faith has been stagnant for thousands of years in the hands of the Vine-Bead Court!
speaker: Enya
content: The reason why you think the people of Kjerag crave stagnation is precisely because Kjeragandr's faith has been stagnant for thousands of years in the hands of the Vine-Bead Court!

raw: [name="Enya"]We've drawn up this land as a prison to preserve the rules of some ancient agreement, surviving in these snow-capped mountains for millennia without exploring or even making contact with the outside world.
speaker: Enya
content: We've drawn up this land as a prison to preserve the rules of some ancient agreement, surviving in these snow-capped mountains for millennia without exploring or even making contact with the outside world.

raw: [name="Enya"]And you mean to tell me this agreement has anything to do with our faith?
speaker: Enya
content: And you mean to tell me this agreement has anything to do with our faith?

raw: [name="Enya"]Is it not just the arrogance of the Vine-Bead Court?
speaker: Enya
content: Is it not just the arrogance of the Vine-Bead Court?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Great Elder"]Arrogance? No, no, this is how things were meant to be!
speaker: Great Elder
content: Arrogance? No, no, this is how things were meant to be!

speaker: Enya
content: Nothing is inherently meant to be.

raw: [name="Enya"]If it seems that way, it's only because it's never been changed.
speaker: Enya
content: If it seems that way, it's only because it's never been changed.

speaker: Enya
content: It's time to change, Great Elder.

raw: [name="Great Elder"]No, Saintess, you cannot change anything.
speaker: Great Elder
content: No, Saintess, you cannot change anything.

raw: [name="Great Elder"]Faith... *cough* *cough*... is the fundamental reason why Kjerag is Kjerag.
speaker: Great Elder
content: Faith... *cough* *cough*... is the fundamental reason why Kjerag is Kjerag.

raw: [name="Enya"]I will go and face Enciodes, but not in the way you want.
speaker: Enya
content: I will go and face Enciodes, but not in the way you want.

speaker: Enya
content: I don't know if I'll succeed.

raw: [name="Enya"]But, since the Saintess has always been used by the Vine-Bead Court as a tool to guide the peoples' faith...
speaker: Enya
content: But, since the Saintess has always been used by the Vine-Bead Court as a tool to guide the peoples' faith...

raw: [name="Enya"]I shall put this tool to good use.
speaker: Enya
content: I shall put this tool to good use.

raw: [name="Enya"]I am the Saintess, but I am not the Saintess of the Vine-Bead Court. I am the Saintess of Kjerag.
speaker: Enya
content: I am the Saintess, but I am not the Saintess of the Vine-Bead Court. I am the Saintess of Kjerag.

raw: [name="Enya"]I will use my own methods to guide the people to freedom. The freedom to progress, to explore, to take risks.
speaker: Enya
content: I will use my own methods to guide the people to freedom. The freedom to progress, to explore, to take risks.

raw: [name="Enya"]And as for you, Great Elder, it is time to rest.
speaker: Enya
content: And as for you, Great Elder, it is time to rest.

raw: [name="Enya"]Attendants, come help the Great Elder away.
speaker: Enya
content: Attendants, come help the Great Elder away.

raw: Enya stands up and walks to the door of the great hall, her eyes fixed forward.
content: Enya stands up and walks to the door of the great hall, her eyes fixed forward.

raw: Behind her, the Great Elder occupies his same seat, watching her back grow ever smaller in the distance. He stretches out his hand as to grasp something, but finally, powerlessly, it drops.
content: Behind her, the Great Elder occupies his same seat, watching her back grow ever smaller in the distance. He stretches out his hand as to grasp something, but finally, powerlessly, it drops.
He grasps nothing at all.

raw: He remains there evermore, motionless, just like the snow of Kjerag blanketing his dreams.
content: He remains there evermore, motionless, just like the snow of Kjerag blanketing his dreams.
